description: Current system imbalance (Historical data - up to 22/05/2024) is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. Instantaneous system imbalance and net regulation volume (and its components) in Elia’s control area. All published values are non-validated values and can only be used for information purposes.﻿This dataset contains data until 21/05/2024 (before MARI local go-live). Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Balancing. Its keywords are Market, Imbalance prices. The portal shows 2025-08-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
